using Printf

function main()
    data = [
        ("Tanaka", 78, 85, 94),
        ("Suzuki", 88, 74, 82),
        ("Yamada", 65, 90, 71),
        ("Ito", 80, 79, 85),
        ("Kato", 92, 88, 95),
        ("Mori", 70, 62, 78),
    ]
    students = [(name = row[1], total = row[2]+row[3]+row[4]) for row in data]
    sort!(students; by = student -> (-student.total, student.name))
    rank = 0
    previous = -1
    for (position, student) in enumerate(students)
        if student.total != previous
            rank = position
        end
        @printf(
            "%d. %s total=%d average=%.2f\n",
            rank,
            student.name,
            student.total,
            student.total/3
        )
        previous = student.total
    end
end

main()
